body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~56 files / ~11,600 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample world position).

**Map sizes curated** (126 / 190-default / 254 — each just under a 64 boundary). `MapSizes` swapped by reflection for the dialog's duration only; `Clamp` snaps to an offered size.

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between `RegionType.Portal` ends (stairs subclass `Building_Door`) conduct connectivity **without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **We patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal** — the perf-mod compat guarantee. Portal regions are ONE CELL; `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M`.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site; never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder (traversal at `Pawn_PathFollower`) · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
`ScenParts` (41) spawns colonists mid-generation. **Carve runs in a `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix** (before `FinalizeInit`). Genstep-time band math uses `TryPendingSurfaceRect`. Start spot clamped at genstep 40 (+24-cell pod margin) + `RescueStrandedColonists` + full-band sweep with census + **`CarveStartClearing`** on zero-standable surfaces (mountain-base start; verified in play — run #131 showed it also fires on ~all-water ocean tiles; log message says "solid rock", cosmetic mislabel, keys on zero standable cells).

---

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (2026-07-28 — root-caused, fix pending verification)

Reload broke everything at once (`Banded == false` everywhere). **Mechanism — cache poisoning:** on load, `Map.ExposeData` runs `ConstructComponents()` first (fresh EMPTY `ABBandMap`) and only later deserializes the real one; loading from a running game keeps the main thread rendering → camera clamp → `CompOf(Find.CurrentMap)` mid-load → latches the empty instance into CWT + memo. **Fix, two layers:** (1) `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive`; (2) `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit` unconditionally `RebindAfterLoad`s every cache + drops the biome memo.

**Also fixed:** `ABWormhole.byMap`/`spikeLayouts` uniqueID-keyed statics → `ConditionalWeakTable<Map,…>`; load-time camera move deferred via `LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished` (Unity API on worker thread threw silently).

**Verification pending:** load from menu · load-while-playing (the poisoning case) · save/load double cycle · `AB2: band info` after each.

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / SKY VEGETATION / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell is a parameter) · sky biome locked to surface · `SeedFlora` · Biomes! Caverns basements (band-scoped carve, scribed `basementBiome`, foreign gensteps confined). Compat watch: perf-mod biome caching → `AB2: biome report` `<-- MISMATCH`. Stalagmite-leak check + Earthen Depths temp still pending.

# 4. CAMERA — verified in play
`viewBand` on the component · free pan via `CurrentViewRect` clip (memoized, gated, never degenerate) · `ABBandCurtain` draws `map.MapEdgeMaterial` at `WorldClipper` altitude.

# 5. MAP GENERATION — profiled, ~4× faster, closed
`ABGenProfile` + carve stopwatches. Real mechanism = **crowdedness** (linear `ListerThings.Remove`). Decisive fix: `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands`. Carve 16.9 s → ~4.2 s. Remaining fat documented: cavern spawn-then-hollow, RockChunks scoping.

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — measured, 96 pawns
59.6 fps vsync-pinned; mod ≈ 2% frame budget. `CompOf` front cache (immutable pair). Phase-skip in below-draw tried and REVERTED. All new visual work (fans, fades, rings) is **bake-time section-mesh geometry — zero per-frame cost**.

# 7. SKY SYNC / BELOW-DRAW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync (roof beats edifice; `AB_WallTop` dontRender + `ShowsBelow`); suspended during carve. Below-draw: pawns + non-pawn realtime things, all three phases unconditionally.

**Vanilla-parity border stack (2026-07-29, untested):** shared `ABNineFan` (vanilla's 9-vert cell fan: SW-first perimeter + center, 8 tris, no uvs — fog index space, cardinal claims its edge's 3 points, diagonal its corner).
- **Below fog** (`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`): hard per-cell FogOfWar quads → vanilla `SectionLayer_FogOfWar` corner smoothing sampled one band down ("black squares around minable rock" fix). Fogged cell = all-covered fan; explored cell gets the partial skirt from fogged neighbours. Off-map/gutter counts as fogged (seamless to band edge). Fog altitude raised Filth → FogOfWar (depth-test safety over cutout wall prints).
- **Below edge shadows** (`SectionLayer_ABBelowEdgeShadows`, in the BelowShadows file): vanilla `SectionLayer_EdgeShadows` ported VERBATIM (four asymmetric corner blocks, 0.45 reach, `MatBases.EdgeShadow`), casters sampled one band down, emitted at above coords, masked by `ShowsBelow`. Gutter/off-map casts nothing.
- **Meadow fade** (`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`): run-44 flat-tone skirt strips DELETED → the meadow terrain's own material (world-position-sampled) as a 9-vert fade fan OVER the mass cell — the real vanilla fade mechanic (ground creeping onto rock). Clones re-queued `lowQueue+2+spread` (spread = compressed renderPrecedence, preserves soil-beats-gravel-beats-rough), clamped under Cutout; fan at +0.04 alt bias to win cutout depth ties. `Linked()` still treats meadow as linked (no lip; fade supplies the transition). Applies in atlas AND BM-variant modes. **`IsMeadowGround` broadened (user seam report): not just literal Soil/Gravel — any non-Hard natural ground or fertility>0 arable, i.e. the rocks' own ROUGH terrain patches and biome-specific soils. RoughHewn (mined floors) stays natural=false ⇒ still MASS, no overlap. Built floors stay hard (vanilla look); water excluded outright (never clone water materials into foreign queues).**
- **Drop-off ring** (`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`): open-air cells bordering the mass get an EdgeShadow fan (195-gray contact line) INTO the open-air cell over the see-below view — the elevation cue at the cliff lip (ledges have no edifice, so vanilla EdgeShadows never fires there).

# 8. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested)

| Def | Footprint | Connects |
|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | one direction |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | one direction |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | one direction |
| **`AB2_Elevator`** | **2×2** | **every level, full mesh** |

Counterpart rework done: `List<Building_ABStairs2> counterparts` (LookMode.Reference), legacy `AB2_counterpart` migrates at PostLoadInit. Elevator spawns a car on every other band, FULL MESH; destroying any member collapses the shaft. Orders pick the end on the viewed band. Metallic-only, costStuffCount 150. Known: `Carry` latent hole (landing exactly on realDest) unfixed.
Stairs stall history (all resolved): tickerType Never ⇒ `openInt` forced · 2×2 rotation offset · landing pocket `ExpandedBy(LandingRadius)` · **`placeWorkers` REPLACES on inherit — `DoorLearnOpeningSpeed` restated**.

# 9. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred
BM swaps rock `graphicData` (Graphic_Random 2×2) + rebuilds the 5 stone terrain graphics + per-map ore recolors via `graphicInt` poke, at startup AND on settings apply. Covered: cap-layer variant mode + live-graphic cache validation (run-53); below `t.Print` reads live graphics (ore recolors included); below terrain via `TerrainGrid.GetMaterial`. **Fixed this session:** `ABMinedRockLookup` color no longer baked-once — def map static, color read LIVE from graphicData (mid-game BM settings changes now track). Mountains Retexture (also in user's list) is texture-only, transparent to us. Co-load verification run pending (user deferred).

# 10. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · why is this pawn stuck · ABStuckWatchdog (verdict-contradiction unfixed) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles (`DrawBelowAirMask` gates fog fans too) · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · `AB2: toggle cap corner fillers`.

# 11. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify visual border batch** (run #131 rolled ~98% ocean — unusable; relaunch needed): basement rock border soft from above · walls have contact shadows in below view · plateau edge = ground-onto-rock fade against ALL plateau floors (soil, gravel, rough patches) with no lip seam · cliff lip shadow ring at drops · no queue inversions.
2. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
3. **Verify elevator** (cars on all bands, full mesh in band info, shaft collapse, legacy-save migration).
4. **COMBAT** — 575 LOC, never verified.
5. **WATERFALLS — stored for next session.** Design sketch agreed: general rule = upper-band water terrain adjacent to a `ShowsBelow` cell ⇒ fall lip; render as animated strip down the SOUTH-facing drop face (top-down camera: north faces invisible, vanilla wall-face language) + fleck mist + sustainer at the base. Today no such adjacency generates naturally — scope choice pending: (a) full feature incl. sky-gen plateau streams, (b) renderer-only (player-made waterfalls via pumped water at shaft edges), (c) later.
6. Mountain sun-shadow onto surface below (parked — needs tuning, behind toggle) · vertical power conduit · isolated DrawDynamicThings run · compat audit · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths · transplant · reachability-as-proxy audit.

# 12. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · per-cell gensteps scope safely, area-count scatterers don't · reuse the engine's object (BiomeAt/CurrentViewRect/MapEdgeMaterial/**the 9-vert fan + its materials**) · **fog border softness lives in the EXPLORED neighbours' partial fans, not the fogged cells** · **classify terrain by PROPERTY (natural/fertility/edgeType), not def identity — generated + biome-specific defs slip through literal matches** · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak across loads AND games — key by Map/CWT · never cache comps while Scribe is active · FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread · distrust confident ordering comments · "nothing drawn" ≠ black · altitude ≠ draw order (but cutout depth-writes make altitude a TIEBREAKER — bias custom geometry above depth-writing atlas fills) · float Color ≠ Color32 · Unity errors bypass the bridge · a green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · verdicts contradicting their own data are worse than none · **build-once color caches go stale under mods that re-apply settings mid-game — read def state live**.

# 13. PUBLISHING
Store page rewritten honestly (update when elevator + visual batch verify). known-issues.json v2 (10 entries — no-elevator entry stale; "hard fog squares in below view" entry now fixed-pending-verification too). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ `ChaoticEnrico.BetterMountains` only for BM compat runs — NOT the current batch, user wants vanilla-look verification first). Playing-gated debug actions via Debug Actions menu. New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing specifically. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
